replacements.source_zh: PAIA 不默认把完整档案交给外部 AI。外部 AI 处理须先获得相应许可，并仅使用必要材料。自动维护按用户选择的设置运行，主动生成由用户发起；真实服务尚未开放。AI Context 的读取许可由用户分别控制；连接不会自动开放卡片或主题。
replacements.source_en: PAIA does not give external AI the complete archive by default. External AI processing requires corresponding permission and uses only necessary material. Automatic maintenance follows the user’s chosen settings; users initiate active generation. These services are not available yet. Users control AI Context reading permissions separately; a connection does not automatically open cards or topics.
replacements.zh: PAIA 不默认把完整档案交给外部 AI。外部 AI 处理须先获得相应许可，并仅使用必要材料。自动维护按用户选择的设置运行，主动生成由用户发起。AI Context 的读取许可由用户分别控制；连接不会自动开放卡片或主题。
replacements.en: PAIA does not give external AI your complete archive by default. Processing requires permission and only the necessary material. Automatic maintenance follows your settings; generation is initiated by you. Context reading permissions are separate, and connecting does not open cards or topics automatically.

replacements.source_zh: 当前公开展示网站不连接用户的 PAIA 档案，也不设置分析脚本或行为跟踪器。网站仅用于说明产品理念、交互与当前开发状态。
replacements.source_en: This public website does not connect to a user’s PAIA archive or install analytics scripts or behavioral trackers. It explains the product, interactions and current development status.
replacements.zh: 本网站用于介绍 PAIA、提供交互演示与使用帮助，不连接用户的 PAIA 档案，也不设置分析脚本或行为跟踪器。
replacements.en: This website introduces PAIA, provides an interactive demo and offers help. It does not connect to your PAIA archive or install analytics or behavioral trackers.

replacements.source_zh: PAIA 仍处于 Private Beta。具体数据结构、同步方式和可选 AI 功能可能继续调整。若未来启用已规划的个人云同步或新的外部 AI 服务，会在正式启用前更新本政策并说明相应数据边界。
replacements.source_en: PAIA remains in private beta. Data structures, synchronization approaches and optional AI features may change. Before planned personal-cloud sync or new external AI services are activated, this policy will be updated and their data boundaries explained before activation.
replacements.zh: 服务、数据结构与可选功能发生变化时，会在相应服务启用前说明数据处理范围并更新本政策。未经相应许可，不会因网站展示或功能升级自动开放你的档案。
replacements.en: When services, data structures or optional features change, their data boundaries will be explained and this policy updated before activation. A website demonstration or an upgrade does not authorize access to your archive.

replacements.source_zh: 产品目标是让用户保留对自己档案的最终控制权，包括查看、编辑、管理允许范围和删除。具体能力以当前 Beta 版本实际提供的功能为准。
replacements.source_en: The product aims to keep users in control of their archives, including viewing, editing, managing access permissions and deleting. Specific capabilities depend on what the current beta build actually provides.
replacements.zh: 用户保留对自己档案的控制，包括查看、编辑、管理允许范围和删除。可用功能和支持环境以安装入口与使用帮助中的说明为准。
replacements.en: You remain in control of viewing, editing, permissions and deletion. Available features and supported environments are described at the installation entry and in Help.

replacements.source_zh: PAIA 当前处于 Private Beta。功能、数据结构、界面和支持范围可能持续变化，部分能力可能不稳定或暂时不可用。
replacements.source_en: PAIA is currently in private beta. Features, data structures, interfaces and support scope may change. Some capabilities may be unstable or temporarily unavailable.
replacements.zh: 使用前请核对安装入口的支持环境和权限说明。本网站的交互演示独立于安装后的产品，不连接个人档案，也不构成任何服务的自动开通。
replacements.en: Check the supported environment and permissions before installing. This website’s interactive demo is separate from the installed product, does not connect to personal archives and does not activate any service.

replacements.source_zh: 在 Beta 阶段，用户不应把 PAIA 作为自己重要数据的唯一副本。对于需要长期保存的内容，请同时保留独立备份。
replacements.source_en: During beta, do not use PAIA as the only copy of important data. Keep independent backups of material that needs long-term preservation.
replacements.zh: 请勿将 PAIA 作为重要数据的唯一副本。对于需要长期保存的内容，请同时保留原平台或其他独立来源。
replacements.en: Do not use PAIA as the only copy of important data. Retain the original platform or another independent source for material that needs long-term preservation.

replacements.source_zh: Beta 版本按当前状态提供，不承诺持续、无错误或永久可用。产品会尽力降低数据风险，但用户仍应为重要资料保留独立备份。
replacements.source_en: The beta is provided in its current state, without a promise of continuous, error-free or permanent availability. The product seeks to reduce data risks, but users should keep independent backups of important material.
replacements.zh: 服务按其实际提供的状态使用，不承诺持续、无错误或永久可用。PAIA 致力于降低数据风险；重要资料仍应保留独立副本。
replacements.en: Services are used as provided, without a promise of continuous, error-free or permanent availability. PAIA seeks to reduce data risks; keep an independent copy of important material.

replacements.zh: 保存、处理、读取与同步，分别由你决定。
replacements.en: Decide separately what is kept, processed, read and synced.

replacements.source_zh: 本地优先不等于材料永不离开设备。计划中的 AI 整理与自动维护，在得到相应处理许可后使用必要材料；外部 AI 连接另有读取许可。
replacements.source_en: Local-first does not mean material can never leave your device. Planned AI organization and automatic maintenance use necessary material under processing permission. External AI connections have separate reading permissions.
replacements.zh: 本地优先不等于材料永不离开设备。AI 整理与自动维护使用必要材料，需要相应的处理许可；外部 AI 的读取另有独立许可。
replacements.en: Local-first does not mean material can never leave your device. Organization and automatic maintenance require permission to process necessary material. External AI reading has separate permissions.

replacements.source_zh: 可选同步的正式方向是自己的浏览器云账号。主动开启后，可在同一生态的新设备恢复已成功同步的数据；真实传输和恢复仍在开发，不会自动跨生态互通。无需建立 PAIA 内容云账号。
replacements.source_en: Optional sync is planned through your own browser cloud account. Once enabled, a new device in the same ecosystem can restore successfully synced data. Live transfer and recovery remain in development. There is no automatic cross-ecosystem sync or required PAIA content-cloud account.
replacements.zh: 按需同步到自己的浏览器云账号，在同一生态的设备间接续已同步资料。不自动跨生态互通，也无需建立 PAIA 内容云账号。具体支持环境在安装入口中说明。
replacements.en: Use your own browser cloud account to continue with synced material across devices in the same ecosystem. No automatic cross-ecosystem sync or PAIA content-cloud account. Supported environments are described at the installation entry.

replacements.source_zh: 官方历史文件导入、已有备份文件恢复和故障恢复保留在正式计划中。生成内容导出、生成新备份和 Context 打包分享已不属于当前产品方向。同步也不等于无限期备份。
replacements.source_en: Official history-file import, recovery from existing backup files and failure recovery remain in the product plan. Content exports, generating new backups and packaged Context sharing are not part of the current direction. Sync is not an unlimited backup history.
replacements.zh: 导入官方历史、恢复已有文件与故障恢复，是不同的操作。同步不是无限期备份；读取许可也不等于生成或分享一份内容包。
replacements.en: Importing official history, recovering an existing file and recovering from a failure are different operations. Sync is not unlimited backup history, and read access is not permission to generate or share a content package.

replacements.source_zh: 测试版不应成为重要资料的唯一副本。按获邀版本的说明操作，并保留原平台或其他独立来源。本地存储不代表加密或永久无损保证。
replacements.source_en: The beta should not be the only copy of important material. Follow the instructions for your invited build and retain the original platform or another independent source. Local storage is not an encryption or permanent lossless-storage guarantee.
replacements.zh: 重要资料请保留原平台或其他独立来源。本地存储不等于加密，也不是永久无损保存的保证。
replacements.en: Keep the original platform or another independent source for important material. Local storage does not imply encryption or guaranteed permanent preservation.

replacements.source_zh: 安装或保存本身不会自动开放整个档案。真实 AI 整理与外部连接仍在开发，官网展示的是正式计划的目标体验。
replacements.source_en: Installation or capture does not open the whole archive. Live AI organization and external connections are still in development; the website illustrates the experience in the approved plan.
replacements.zh: 安装或保存不会自动开放整个档案。处理许可与读取许可相互独立；开放范围始终由你决定。
replacements.en: Installing or saving does not open your archive. Processing and reading permissions are separate. You choose the scope.

replacements.source_zh: AI 不应替你发明观点，也不应因为概括得更顺畅，就删去原本关键的限制条件。真实 AI 整理服务仍在开发。
replacements.source_en: AI should not invent a position for you or remove a crucial condition for the sake of a smoother summary. The live AI organization service is still in development.
replacements.zh: AI 不应替你发明观点，也不应为了概括得更顺畅，删去关键的限制条件。整理后的内容仍应能回到原始来源。
replacements.en: AI should not invent your beliefs or remove important conditions to make a summary smoother. An organized view should remain traceable to its source.

replacements.source_zh: 它们互相补充，不要求你每次复制整段历史。真实 Context 连接仍在开发，本地提示词能力以获邀版本为准。
replacements.source_en: They complement one another without asking you to copy an entire history. Real Context connections are still in development. Local prompt availability depends on the invited build.
replacements.zh: 它们互相补充，不要求你每次复制整段历史。背景和读取范围由你管理，提示词在需要时随手复用。
replacements.en: They complement each other without requiring you to paste entire histories. Manage background and access, then reuse your prompts when needed.

replacements.source_zh: 主动开启后，PAIA 可参考刚完成的回复，找到适合接着用的已有提示词。本页只有预设示例，不读取真实对话。
replacements.source_en: After you enable it, PAIA can use the latest reply locally to suggest a saved prompt. This page uses only a preset and reads no real conversation.
replacements.zh: 主动开启后，参考刚完成的回复，从已有提示词中选择适合接着用的表达。始终由你检查并发送。
replacements.en: After you opt in, use the latest reply to find a useful expression among your saved prompts. You review it and decide when to send.

replacements.source_zh: 日常保存、查找、编辑和提示词复用在本地完成。计划中的可选同步会使用你自己的浏览器云账号，让同一生态的新设备恢复已成功同步的资料。
replacements.source_en: Everyday capture, search, editing and prompt reuse work locally. Planned optional sync will use your own browser cloud account to restore successfully synced material on a new device in the same ecosystem.
replacements.zh: 日常保存、查找、编辑与提示词复用，在本地完成。按需使用自己的浏览器云账号，在同一生态的设备间接续已同步的资料。
replacements.en: Everyday capture, search, editing and prompt reuse work locally. Use your own browser cloud account to continue with synced material across devices in the same ecosystem.

replacements.source_zh: 由你主动开启；真实云同步仍在开发。不同浏览器生态之间不会自动互通。
replacements.source_en: You choose whether to enable it. Cloud sync is still in development; different browser ecosystems will not sync with one another automatically.
replacements.zh: 同步由你主动开启，不同浏览器生态之间不会自动互通。
replacements.en: Sync is your choice. Different browser ecosystems do not sync with one another automatically.

replacements.source_zh: 修改只保留在本页。计划中的自动维护会尊重你的修改和删除。
replacements.source_en: Edits stay on this page. Planned automatic maintenance will respect your edits and removals.
replacements.zh: 你的修改和删除，始终有自己的位置。演示中的编辑只保留在本页。
replacements.en: Your edits and removals stay in your control. Demo edits remain on this page.

replacements.source_zh: 用四张卡片管理背景、规则、近况和开放的主题。连接可用后，获准的 AI 将按需读取，不必每次整理一份材料。你随时可以修改内容、暂停访问或撤回允许。
replacements.source_en: Manage your background, rules, current work and open topics in four cards. Once connections are available, an authorized AI will read what it needs within your permissions. Edit the content, pause access or withdraw permission whenever you choose.
replacements.zh: 用四张卡片管理背景、规则、近况与主题。由你决定 AI 可以读取什么，随时修改内容、暂停访问或撤回允许。
replacements.en: Manage your background, rules, current work and topics in four cards. You decide what AI may read. Edit the content, pause access or withdraw permission at any time.

replacements.source_zh: 获邀安装后，主动开启保存。PAIA 留下受支持 ChatGPT 页面中已发送的用户文字，连同来源和时间。
replacements.source_en: After installing your invited build, turn on capture. PAIA keeps sent user text from supported ChatGPT pages, together with its source and time.
replacements.zh: 安装后，主动开启保存。留下你在 ChatGPT 中已发送的文字，连同来源和时间。
replacements.en: Install PAIA and turn on capture. Keep the words you send in ChatGPT, together with their source and time.

replacements.source_zh: 用四张卡片管理背景、规则、近况和允许读取的主题。真实连接可用后，获准的 AI 可以按需读取。
replacements.source_en: Use four cards for your background, rules, current context and allowed topics. Once live connections are available, authorized AI can read when needed.
replacements.zh: 用四张卡片管理背景、规则、近况与主题。只让获准的 AI 读取需要的内容。
replacements.en: Use four cards for your background, rules, current context and topics. Let authorized AI read only what it needs.

replacements.source_zh: 用户对自己输入、编辑和导入的内容保留相应权利。PAIA 的产品目标是让这些内容保持可查看、可编辑和可管理；当前计划不提供内容导出或新备份生成。
replacements.source_en: Users retain the relevant rights in content they enter, edit and import. PAIA aims to make this material viewable, editable and manageable. The current plan does not provide content exports or generation of new backups.
replacements.zh: 用户对自己输入、编辑和导入的内容保留相应权利。PAIA 提供内容查看、编辑与管理；不提供内容导出或生成新备份。
replacements.en: Users retain the relevant rights in content they enter, edit and import. PAIA provides viewing, editing and management, not content exports or generation of new backups.
